description: Read one published daily breaking-changes digest: AI/dev API status flips, model deprecations and retirements, pricing-page edits, and breaking MCP server changes. Use for a once-a-day catch-up. For a filtered on-demand API feed with no MCP section, use list_recent_api_changes; for live up/down, check_api_status; for one model id, check_model_deprecation. Always free (no quota, no x402). Published once at 12:00 UTC as a frozen window since the previous issue (usually ~24h); not updated later. Omit date for the latest; a missing YYYY-MM-DD returns 404 {error:no_issue}. One issue per date, no paging. Returns {date, title, summary, window_start, window_end, published_at, markdown, data, url, sponsor:null}. data holds counts, status, open_now, model_changes, shutting_down_30d, pricing, deprecation_page_edits, and mcp (breaking, non_breaking, down, back, auth_broken, auth_fixed). markdown caps model rows, breaking MCP rows, and each MCP event kind at 30, 30, and 20; data is the full window.

date.description: Published issue date, YYYY-MM-DD (example 2026-10-14). Omit for the latest issue. A date with no stored issue returns 404 no_issue; issues appear at 12:00 UTC.

name: get_digest
title: Daily AI/dev API breaking-changes digest
